verdicts.explanation: The introduction states LGPS (Li10GeP2S12, ref. 24) has a room-temperature conductivity of 12 mS cm-1, a value quoted from prior work. Unit, RT temperature (null in C) and literature_cited origin are all correct.
The introduction states Li7P3S11 (ref. 18) has 17 mS cm-1 at RT, cited from prior work, so the value, unit, temperature and literature_cited origin are right.

The paper says the Cl-doped Li9.54Si1.74P1.44S11.7Cl0.3 shows a state-of-the-art conductivity of 25 mS/cm at RT with citation 13, so it is a literature value. Cl as dopant is stated and RT maps to null correctly.
Section 4 says Hayashi et al. (ref. 178) reported a Na3PS4 glass-ceramic with ~0.2 mS cm-1 at 25 °C, so the value, unit, 25 °C and literature_cited origin match.

field_errors.evidence: much higher than the previous AIMD calculated result of 0.088 mS/cm and even the experimental values

verdicts.explanation: Material, value, literature_cited origin (previous AIMD from ref. 83, also in Table 3) and null temperature are right. The paper never labels this value as 'total', so conductivity_kind should be unspecified.
